_comment: Editable step content for the guided tour. Each step's 'id' must match a wiring entry in MainWindow._tutorial_step_wiring() (that map owns the target widget + tab-switch action; this file owns the user-facing copy). Reorder this array to change tour order; remove an entry to skip it; add a new id here + a matching wiring entry to add a step. Allowed preferred_side values: above, below, left, right, auto.

steps.title: Welcome to Smart Citizen
steps.description: This quick tour covers the core workflow of customizing strings and applying the result back to Star Citizen. Many of these steps run automatically, but can be done manually if needed. You can skip anytime.

steps.title: 1. Extract from Data.p4k
steps.description: Clicking Extract unpacks your installed game's stock localization file. You should be prompted to run this if your current file becomes stale due to a patch, but if not, you can always run it manually. The strings reload into the table automatically when extraction finishes.

steps.title: 2. Enhancements
steps.description: Optional but recommended: the Enhancements tab toggles stat overlays for ships, components, weapons, mission blueprints/rewards, and commodity crafting. Use the Tag Builder to customize the bracketed prefix tags on components, missiles, ship weapons, and commodities. Mission Labels lets you rename section headers (MISSION DETAILS, POTENTIAL BLUEPRINTS, etc.) and the XP label. Generate Enhancements runs the pipeline that produces those overlays from your extracted data.

steps.title: 3. Edit strings
steps.description: Each row is one localization record. Double-click a cell in the Custom Value column to edit — your changes are autosaved. The ★ column marks ships as favorites so they sort to the top of the ASOP.

steps.title: 4. Filter by column
steps.description: The row of search boxes under the column headers filters the table as you type. Each box scopes to its own column (Key, Default Value, Current Value, Custom Value); filters across columns combine with AND. Click the × inside a box to clear it.

steps.title: 5. Editor pane
steps.description: For longer strings click Editor to open a side-docked editing canvas with more room. The pane follows the row you select; right-click selected text for Underline / Highlight emphasis. Drag the title bar to undock it into a free-floating window.

steps.title: 6. Preview pane
steps.description: Whenever you select a row, this pane on the right shows the rendered text of its current value.

steps.title: 7. Apply to Game
steps.description: Apply writes the merged result to the game's global.ini. A timestamped backup of the current global.ini is created first (up to 5 are kept, restorable from Restore Backup).

steps.title: 8. Help & feedback
steps.description: The Help button opens a side-panel with the full guide, a Known Issues list, and a feedback link to the Smart Citizen Discord channel. That's everything you need to get started — good luck, citizen.
